name: GTA V (Legacy)
short: Chaos Mod effects, vehicles, weapons, weather and more, set off by gifts
description: Gifts set off things in your Story Mode game: hundreds of Chaos Mod V effects, plus spawning vehicles, weapons, money, wanted levels, weather and teleports from the GiftDeck GTA script. GiftDeck installs Script Hook V, Script Hook V .NET, Chaos Mod V (GiftDeck build) and the GiftDeck GTA script into your game folder, and backs up any file it replaces.
warning: Story Mode only. Script Hook V closes the game if you go Online, and using mods Online can get your Rockstar account banned.

requirements.detail: GiftDeck can't change the game's files while it's running.

Script Hook V comes with an args.txt that starts the game without BattlEye, which is enough for most people. If BattlEye still starts: Rockstar Games Launcher > Settings > Grand Theft Auto V Legacy, untick BattlEye (or put -nobattleye in Launch Arguments).
Never go Online with these mods installed: Script Hook V closes the game if you try, and mods Online can get you banned.
Play through the first mission (the North Yankton robbery) before using the mods. Many effects don't work until it's done.

components.name: Script Hook V
components.license: Free, by Alexander Blade. Not redistributable, so it's always downloaded from dev-c.com.

source.instructions: On the page, press the first Download button (next to Version). Then pick the ScriptHookV_….zip you downloaded.

components.name: Script Hook V .NET
components.license: Free and open source (zlib), github.com/scripthookvdotnet. The nightly build: the last stable one doesn't work with current versions of the game.

components.name: Chaos Mod V (GiftDeck build)
components.license: Free and open source (GPL-3), a GiftDeck build of gta-chaos-mod/ChaosModV: effects run when a gift says so, with no timer or voting.

components.name: GiftDeck GTA script
components.license: Free and open source (MIT), part of GiftDeck. Shows a green greeting in game; F10 opens its menu.
